data.name: Meow Time Machine: VAN GOGH Plus
data.detailed_description:
The Soul Embraced by Colors: Van Gogh's Mystical Artistic Realm

This is an immersive hidden-object puzzle gem that invites you to traverse the river of time, exploring the epic artistic journey of Vincent van Gogh, the great master of Post-Impressionism. From the Yellow House in Arles to the Saint-Rémy Sanatorium shrouded in starry nights, from blooming sunflower fields to the wheat field of his final days, every step forward is a profound inquiry into an artistic soul.

A Wandering Journey Through Art

Embark on a five-chapter spiritual wandering: from Van Gogh’s striking first encounter with Arles, to the golden inspiration bestowed by sunflowers, from dreamlike creations under the starry sky to inner clarity in the sanatorium, and finally to the final farewell in the wheat fields of Auvers-sur-Oise. In each exquisitely crafted scene, you will collect objects closely intertwined with Van Gogh’s life, piecing together the complete spiritual portrait of this artistic master.

Unique Game Experience

  • Exquisite Hand-Painted Scenes: Reconstruct the stages of Van Gogh’s life with Post-Impressionist brushstrokes

  • Nuanced Emotional Quest: Experience the artist’s emotional tides amid the warm sun of Provence, under star-studded nights, and by the iron windows of the sanatorium

  • Fun Quest Challenges: Partner with Van Gogh’s feline companion to gather scattered special items and unlock hidden secrets of the past

  • Immersive Art History Experience: Admire the charm and evolution of Post-Impressionist art in the game, and feel Van Gogh’s profound enlightenment on modern art

Game Features

  • Five carefully polished chapters, each focusing on key milestones in Van Gogh’s life

  • Over 20 distinctive scenes, ranging from Arles Train Station to the golden wheat waves of Auvers-sur-Oise

  • Dozens of core collectibles, including painting tools, pigments, and precious relics from his daily life

  • Exclusive side quests with the feline companion

  • Immersive puzzle-solving that integrates art history knowledge with emotional resonance

Game Instructions

This is a lightweight hidden-object puzzle game consisting of five chapters, with a total playtime of approximately 1-2 hours.

  • Click on either side of the book to flip pages

  • The last page of the book features a multi-language switching function

  • Press the ESC key to exit the game

  • The overall difficulty is moderate. A light bulb icon in the upper right corner of the screen serves as a hint, indicating hidden items to find in the current scene

  • The hint function can be disabled in the settings. Please be advised that disabling hints will significantly increase the game difficulty
